name: Naracoorte
reason: Town with its own Wikivoyage page and listed in the Limestone Coast region page; base for Naracoorte Caves; Sheep's Back Museum in town (rule 1, towns visitors base in).
objection: Wikivoyage's own See entries for the town are thin (museum, gallery); draw is the caves.

name: Beachport
reason: Southaustralia.com names Beachport as a base and lists the Pool of Siloam, Beachport Conservation Park and the jetty area; harbour town second tier.
objection: Only one counted source and the main sights are separate spots.

name: Penola
reason: Coonawarra gateway and Mary MacKillop heritage; no Wikivoyage page and region page only names Coonawarra, the town's own sights (interpretive centre) unverified by a counted source.
objection: For: base for Coonawarra, Mary MacKillop centre. Against: one weak source, cellar doors are not spots.

name: Millicent
reason: Regional hub with the National Trust museum, which southaustralia.com lists (millicent-national-trust-museum); town itself has no guide section.
objection: For: large well-regarded museum and gateway to Canunda. Against: town unnamed by Wikivoyage; museum is the real spot.

name: Port MacDonnell
reason: Southaustralia.com names Port MacDonnell as a stay base on the Limestone Coast; fishing village on Southern Ocean Drive (second-tier harbour town).
objection: Single source; no named sights on the sources I opened.

name: Southend
reason: Southaustralia.com's Limestone Coast beaches section names Southend (listed as an attraction with boating facilities); beach village on Rivoli Bay.
objection: One counted source; Wikivoyage's Southend page is Southend-on-Sea, not this place.

name: Bordertown
reason: Dukes Highway stopover; southaustralia.com lists Bordertown Wildlife Park (white kangaroos) and Recreation Lake; the town itself has no own guide section.
objection: For: white kangaroos are a quirky roadside draw. Against: that draw is the park, not the town; judge the wildlife park as its own place.

name: Tantanoola
reason: Village with no visitor source naming anything to see beyond the caves, which are a separate candidate (Tantanoola Caves); the Tiger is a pub/stuffed animal.
objection: Tantanoola Tiger is a quirky icon, but it lacks a counted source.

name: Mundulla
reason: Dukes Highway village with no counted source naming anything to see.
objection: Could have a mineral springs/heritage mention I did not find.

name: Lucindale

objection: Small chance a guide lists it as a stop.

name: Padthaway
reason: Wine locality: no counted source; cellar doors and an estate operator are not spots (brief: hold the winery line).
objection: The Padthaway Estate homestead is a heritage estate.

name: Carpenter Rocks
reason: Fishing village with no counted source; Cape Banks lighthouse not verified; Canunda covers the coast.
objection: Cape Banks Lighthouse and fishing harbour might be a stop.

name: Nora Creina

objection: Scenic curving bay on Southern Ocean Drive; could be second-tier headland if a guide names it.

name: Cape Jaffa
reason: Locality; the Cape Jaffa Lighthouse is a Kingston SE sight per Wikivoyage (listed under Kingston), not a distinct place at Cape Jaffa; duplicate of the Kingston lighthouse.

name: Nangwarry
reason: Forestry village; the museum has no counted source.
objection: Nangwarry Forestry Museum may be open to the public.

name: Little Blue Lake

name: Valley Lake / Ketla Malpi

name: Mount Gambier (volcano)

name: Mount Schank

name: Fossil Cave
